settings.text_normalization: title + description; lowercase; collapse whitespace; first 2048 characters
settings.semantic_comparison: identical popularity-bin and text-length quotas; nonzero-text eligibility

timestamp_popularity.rule: exp(-(reference - timestamp)/tau); numeric milliseconds >=1e11; naive ISO treated as UTC

settings.candidate_freeze: cached by dataset-local user, interaction index, target and replicate; challenge-specific SHA256 seeds
